decision_stage: after CNN validation, before any test evaluation
observed_issue: Highway recall is 0.3546667; 115 Highway validation images are predicted as River, and 51 River images are predicted as Highway.
hypothesis: Roads and rivers are narrow structures at different orientations. Adding rotations may encourage orientation-independent features and reduce confusion. Orientation has not been established as the cause.
change: Add RandomRotation(0.25) during CNN training only.
controlled_settings: Same split, seed 42, CNN layers, dropout, Adam learning rate, batch size, 15-epoch limit and validation-loss checkpoint selection.
comparison: Validation macro F1 and accuracy, plus Highway recall and Highway/River confusion counts.
success_claim: Only if the measured validation comparison supports it; no guarantee of improvement.
test_policy: Finish this experiment before evaluating final checkpoints on test. Do not change models in response to test results.
